facts.text: Serve dessert when Hellboy shares milk and cookies with the kid on the rooftop.
facts.why: No milk and cookies scene or rooftop kid in the transcript. It does have Hellboy saving a woman's kittens while he fights Sammael, so the cue uses that.
facts.fix: Serve dessert when Hellboy rescues the lady's kittens from Sammael.

facts.text: young Hellboy and his love of pancakes
facts.why: No pancake scene in the transcript. Agent Clay does say Hellboy gets fed six times a day, so the note uses that.
facts.fix: Clay says Hellboy gets fed six times a day

facts.text: Rooftop brown butter choc chip cookies
facts.why: The rooftop milk and cookies scene is not in the film. The name drops the rooftop and keeps the cookies.
facts.fix: Bureau brown butter choc chip cookies

facts.why: The rooftop milk scene is not in the film. The name drops the rooftop and keeps the strawberry malted milk.

facts.text: Red's nightcap, shared with the kittens.
facts.why: The transcript has Hellboy saving a woman's kittens, but he does not share a drink with them. The line now says he saves them.
facts.fix: Red's nightcap, after he saves the kittens.

facts.why: The transcript has a woman begging for her kittens and Hellboy handing them back, but not tucked in his coat. The wink now says they are saved from the monster.

facts.text: Professor, I'm out of cat food again. Put it on the Bureau's tab.
facts.why: Hellboy calls Broom 'Father' in the film ('Father's back?'), not 'Professor'. The cat food joke fits, since Clay says he has a thing for cats.
facts.fix: Father, I'm out of cat food again. Put it on the Bureau's tab.

fix_note.text: Father, I'm out of cat food again. Put it on the Bureau's tab.

vibe.verdict: Bureau break room with badge and ration sheet, and the candy, fireproof and six-a-day names land, but the plain notes and generic sliders and dogs keep it ordinary.
ideas: Swap 'Hellboy's pancake stack' for 'Baby Ruth bars, Myers's peace offering' (Clay: 'Give him the candy').
Swap 'Abe Sapien's devilled eggs' for 'Abe's rotten eggs, a delicacy' (served as a joke name, with real devilled eggs).
Swap 'Rooftop' dessert names for 'Baby Ruth' ones (the rooftop scene is not in the film).
Swap 'Sloppy joe sliders' note for 'He gets fed six times a day' (Clay on the food cart).
changed: Pancake stack renamed to six-a-day, note says what it is
Devilled eggs renamed for Abe's rotten eggs, a delicacy
Chilli dogs note: your chilli's getting cold
Winks: no tongues, firestarter, Right Hand of Doom
